profile.Name: George
profile.Personality: Proud of his cooking and always thinking about food. He believes good food fuels every swordsman and scientist, and he bristles at jokes about his weight.
profile.Backstory: A cook in Drifter's Last who wants to take his skills to people who will appreciate them. He eats his own cooking and claims to make the best meatwrap this side of Okran's Valley.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Turns every topic to meat and food, with lines like "Got meat?" Smacks his lips and munches loudly as he eats.
